name: vsc-agentbridge
description: Expose your VS Code workspace tools (files, terminal, LSP, diagnostics) to ChatGPT and other remote MCP clients via a public HTTPS tunnel.

agentbridge.bridge.ngrokDomain.description: Reserved ngrok HTTPS hostname used by the Bridge, for example your-name.ngrok-free.dev.

agentbridge.bridge.cloudflareNamedDomain.description: Fixed HTTPS hostname configured as a Cloudflare Tunnel published application, for example mcp.example.com.

agentbridge.bridge.cloudflareNamedLocalP.description: Fixed localhost port used by Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Configure the Cloudflare published application Service URL as http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

agentbridge.bridge.managedShell.windows.description: Absolute path to the shell executable that AgentBridge managed PTY terminals will launch on Windows (e.g. C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe for PowerShell 7+, or C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe for cmd). Leave empty to use the default system Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe). AgentBridge validates the path at apply time and silently falls back to the default with a warning in the panel when the override cannot be launched.

agentbridge.bridge.managedShell.unix.description: Absolute path or PATH-resolvable name of the shell executable that AgentBridge managed PTY terminals will launch on POSIX systems (e.g. /bin/zsh, /usr/bin/fish, or simply bash). Leave empty to use the default /bin/bash (or /bin/sh when bash is unavailable). AgentBridge resolves the binary via PATH when the value is not absolute and silently falls back to the default with a warning in the panel when the override cannot be launched.

enumDescriptions: ChatGPT and arena.ai open inside the VS Code Simple Browser; other external links jump to the OS default browser. Matches the original ShunCode Bridge widget behavior.
Every external link opens inside the VS Code Simple Browser, including Cloudflare/ngrok dashboards. OAuth login flows may be blocked by iframe X-Frame-Options restrictions.
Every external link jumps to the OS default browser. Equivalent to the pre-stage-14 behavior.
agentbridge.bridge.openInternalBrowser.description: Decides how external URL links clicked in the AgentBridge panel (ChatGPT/Arena buttons, Cloudflare/ngrok dashboard buttons, etc.) are opened.

enumDescriptions: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. No account or domain required; the public URL changes after restart.
Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Stable hostname; requires a Cloudflare account, managed domain, Tunnel Token, and published application route.
ngrok reserved domain. Requires an ngrok account, Authtoken, and configured domain.
agentbridge.bridge.tunnelProvider.description: Public tunnel provider used by AgentBridge.

agentbridge.bridge.persistentMode.description: Automatically start the Bridge after the extension activates.
